title: 第2002章 吞噬修罗王意识第2001章 差点把自己玩死
slug: 系统伴我成长助我无敌永生
lines: 试禁忌法搞出大头佛，如此大的动静，肯定会引来闻声而动的生灵。
为了安全起见，林羽又重新换了个地。
再次挑了个僻静之所。
在一处陨石群体中，随意挑了块个头大，偏平整的陨石。
刚落在上面。
林羽并没有迫不及待的进行心中想法。
他第一时间是在调养伤势，将自身状态调整到最佳。
资源不缺的情况下，林羽也毫不吝啬。
大把大把的吞噬资源。
他率先找年份长的道药，然后再挑挑拣拣一些品质不错的丹药。
挑出的这批资源，他并没有直接吞服，而是经过了自己的大道真火淬炼。
只有这样，才符合他的高要求。
林羽的这些动作被器灵看在眼里，心痛如绞，在它的潜意识中，人类小子的资源它也有份分一半。
现在还没有分出来，也就是说，对方用的东西里面，也有它的一半。
“人类小子，你手下留情啊！说好了要分一半给本灵，现在你还没分家，就自个先使用了，你还专挑好品质的下手，你不厚道啊！”
正在疗伤的某人实在被吵烦了。
不得已之下，只能无奈开口回应。
“小九，你烦不烦？能不能闭嘴？
本尊挑的是丹药与道药，这对你来说，只是用处不大的东西。
只有源石才最适合你，可以帮你补充元气，本尊事后给你多分点源石，不就行了吗？
再说了，你有这个守奴财的功夫，你都能直接吞噬星辰精气补充自身，你简直在舍本逐末。”
“放屁！人类小子，你以为本灵不想恢复吗？也不知道你这家伙是不是干了什么天怒人怨的事情。
你难道没发现吗？你去到哪里，哪里的星辰精气就变得虚薄，本灵也想自力更生，可是老天爷不给机会啊！”
额！
林羽哑口无言。
他自然知道这件事情，只是他也没办法，这是阴阳无极的手段，他能怎么办？
自己身边有个吞大熔炉，有多少元气精气都不够它吸，这也是他想方设法搞源石，薅资源的原因。
因为实物对自己有利，阴阳无极只针对精元气，源灵气类的虚物下手。
七天后。
林羽眼眸打开，异芒璀璨，他状态调复得差不多了。
“小九，开始吧！为了防止煮熟的鸭子飞走，本尊要进入道钟里面来吞噬修罗王的意识。
content_en:
Try the taboo method to create a big-headed Buddha. Such a big movement will definitely attract creatures that move when they hear the sound.
For safety reasons, Lin Yu changed places again.
Once again, we chose a secluded place.
Among a group of meteorites, I randomly picked a large, flat meteorite.
Just landed on it.
Lin Yu did not wait to carry out his thoughts.
He was recuperating his injuries immediately and adjusting his condition to the best.
Even when there was no shortage of resources, Lin Yu was not stingy.
Devouring resources in abundance.
He first looked for older Tao medicines, and then picked out some good-quality elixirs.
He did not swallow the selected resources directly, but was tempered by the true fire of his own avenue.
Only in this way can it meet his high requirements.
Lin Yu's actions were seen by the weapon spirit, and his heart ached. In its subconscious, it also had half of the human boy's resources.
It hasn't been separated yet, which means that half of the things used by the other party are there.
"Human boy, you are so merciful! We agreed to give half of it to the spirit, but now you are using it yourself before we separate. You also choose good quality ones to start with. You are not kind!"
…
Someone who is recovering from an injury is really annoyed.
As a last resort, I had no choice but to respond.
"Xiaojiu, are you annoyed? Can you shut up?
What I picked was elixirs and Tao medicines, which are of little use to you.
Only the Origin Stone is the most suitable for you and can help you replenish your vitality. I will give you more Origin Stone afterwards, won’t it be enough?
Besides, if you have the skill of keeping slave wealth, you can directly swallow the essence of the stars to replenish yourself. You are simply giving up the good and chasing the weak. "
"Fart! Human boy, do you think your soul doesn't want to recover? I don't know if you have done something outrageous.
Didn't you notice? Wherever you go, the energy of the stars becomes weak. You want to be self-reliant, but God doesn't give you a chance! "
Uh!
Lin Yu was speechless.
Of course he knew about this, but he couldn't do anything about it. This was a yin and yang method. What could he do?
There is a melting pot beside him, and no matter how much energy or essence there is, it is not enough to absorb it. This is why he is trying every means to acquire the source stones and gather resources.
Because physical objects are beneficial to him, Yin Yang Wuji only targets imaginary objects such as essence energy and source spiritual energy.
Seven days later.
Lin Yu's eyes opened, shining brightly, and his condition was almost restored.
"Xiao Jiu, let's start! In order to prevent the cooked duck from flying away, I will enter the Dao Bell to swallow King Shura's consciousness.
title_en: Chapter 2002 Devouring the Consciousness of King Shura Chapter 2001 Nearly Playing Himself to Death
